sections: Evaluator owner, compatibility API, and transport
Reviewable runtime packets after human approval

repo_truth: At HEAD 22c66b14a4c471871f6f590f9fc9bcebe2ff9a6e, the worktree contains the complete uncommitted P2 planning subject at the declared 23-path fingerprint. Production, released definition, and test bytes in the manifest are unchanged from the prior reviewed boundary. The newly authorized repair changes only transaction-store planning semantics and directly coupled planning status text: over-limit now occurs when candidate count exceeds 4096 or the exact projected RFC 8785 directory envelope exceeds 131072 bytes; projection uses checked arithmetic; the offending entry is not retained or serialized; count, byte, and arithmetic failures share one fixed null closure; complete bounded envelopes retain exact fingerprints; and over-limit precedes alias/invalid-name validation. The prior 1102-Unix/558-Windows discovery signal was unadmitted and supplies no verdict. This dispatch requests one independent complete-subject review and grants no runtime or approval authority.
allowed_scope: Read-only independent review of the complete declared 23-path P2 planning subject.
Verify exact checked count and canonical-envelope projection semantics, including fixed empty-envelope sizes, base64 length arithmetic, separators, quotes, and the strict greater-than limits.
Recompute the count 4096/4097, Unix 1101/1102, Windows 557/558, exact 131072/131073-byte, long-name, and arbitrary-suffix vectors and all bounded-envelope SHA-256 values.

Verify the offending entry is never retained or serialized, no partial envelope or fingerprint enters the closure, all limit failures share the exact fixed row, and over-limit precedes alias/invalid validation.
Verify coupled SPEC/plan/todo/control-pack text preserves the planning-only P2S/P2A human gate and introduces no runtime authority.
Identify findings independently, then compare only P3/P4 candidates with the selected-scope inventory.
non_goals: No edit, formatting, staging, commit, push, handoff, ledger write, new dispatch, or delegation.
No P2 Rust, schema, definition, producer, evaluator, native adapter, CLI/compiler, Environment Context, or runtime approval.
No P2S/P2A approval, P4 proof, P6, Phase 2 exit, HCM-3.x, another slice, or unrelated cleanup.
No admission of the prior unvalidated discovery signal as a review result.
No remediation loop: report any valid P1/P2 and stop.
tasks: Replay the manifest and confirm aggregate subject identity before semantic review.
Read the selected true stop and complete planning subject without inheriting its conclusions.
Recompute the canonical envelope-size formula and every supplied threshold, full-envelope byte count, and bounded-envelope fingerprint independently.

Confirm strict entry-count and projected-byte ceilings, checked-arithmetic failure behavior, offender non-retention, zero partial serialization/fingerprinting, fixed closure equivalence, and limit precedence over alias/invalid validation.
Confirm the six store rows remain exhaustive for the selected failures and do not contradict scalar bounds, first-match outcome precedence, fixed transport, or no-discovery rules.
Confirm coupled planning wording grants no runtime, schema, definition, P2S/P2A approval, P4, P6, Phase 2, or sibling authority.
Return findings first in Critical, Required, Optional, Nit order with exact file/line, violated contract or gate, why it is wrong, smallest valid remediation, and missing verification.
contracts_and_gates: Over-limit occurs exactly when candidate entry count exceeds 4096 or candidate canonical envelope size exceeds 131072 bytes.
Projected RFC 8785 envelope size is exact on Unix and Windows and every add/multiply is checked.
The offending entry is not retained or serialized; no complete or partial over-limit envelope or fingerprint enters the observation or closure.
The exact over-limit first row uses directory_limit_exceeded, the fixed five-null tuple, and transaction_store_over_limit.
Count, byte, and checked-arithmetic over-limit failures intentionally share one fixed failure row and closure.
Every bounded directory retains and fingerprints its complete canonical envelope.
Either over-limit ceiling wins before alias and invalid-name validation, including when earlier retained names are invalid.
The required count, platform threshold, exact byte-boundary, long-name, and arbitrary-suffix vectors are deterministic and arithmetically correct.
No released condition, production, test, schema, or definition byte changes.
Planning CLEAN may permit only a reviewed planning commit, separate mechanical closeout, and later distinct P2S/P2A human approval.
A valid P1/P2 produces verdict findings and a top-level truthful stop without remediation.
stop_conditions: Return blocked if subject identity or required read-only evidence cannot be established.
Report rather than repair any finding.
Do not request or perform runtime/schema/definition/P2S/P2A/P4/P6/sibling expansion.
Do not create another review cycle, dispatch, handoff, ledger entry, commit, or user task hop.
